segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so quick pipeline check before forecast. We’ve got Northstar Foods at 42 seats, renewal value is $31,680, starts March 1, and BrightPath Manufacturing is 58 seats plus the onboarding package, $48,900 total.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. Northstar was supposed to close Friday, right? What’s actually left on that one?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Northstar is still stalled until legal signs off on the 90-day termination language. I’ve nudged Maya in legal every morning since Tuesday, plus sent the redline thread again yesterday afternoon, and procurement won’t release the PO until that answer comes back. Like, the customer is ready, the invoice contact is set, but the deal is just sitting there waiting on that internal sign-off.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. If it comes back clean today, can billing still get the invoice out for March 1?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, billing said if I submit the order by 3 p.m. Pacific they can issue it today. Seats are already updated in the CRM, and the pricing sheet matches the renewal quote.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Good. What about BrightPath? I saw the close date moved to February 28.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: BrightPath is also stuck waiting on another department. Their IT lead asked for our answer on data retention for deleted user records, and security has to approve the response before I send it. I’ve nudged the security queue twice, messaged Tom directly, and the buyer keeps asking if we can confirm by end of week. Until that sign-off lands, they won’t countersign or lock the April 8 go-live, so the deal is sitting stalled even though pricing and seats are done.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Understood. For BrightPath, are they still at 58 seats or did they add the five operations managers?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Still 58 for the initial order. They may add the five in Q3, but I kept this order clean: 58 annual seats, standard support, and one remote admin training session.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay, forecast Northstar as commit if legal comes back today, BrightPath as best case. Send me the order links after this so I can sanity check the dates.
